subject: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment & technical deep dive for Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment & technical deep dive for Acme Health

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: reduce gen-LM inference costs for patient-facing NLP features while keeping latency under 300ms p95.
- Current constraints: on-prem data residency and EKS for control plane, procurement timeline targeted for end of Q3.
- Key stakeholders: you (VP Product), Carlos (CTO), security/compliance (TBD).

Proposed next steps to unblock procurement: 
1) Exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) — 30m to align on risk/SLAs, deployment model (Private vs Dedicated), and contract cadence.
2) Technical deep dive with our SE (Neha) — 45m demo of inference runtime, KV/prefix caching, and quantization recommendations.

Suggested times (all PT):
- Tue May 14, 10:00–10:30am PT — Exec alignment (30m)
- Wed May 15, 3:00–3:45pm PT — Technical deep dive (45m)

Attachments: Redwood capabilities deck and a short mutual action plan (stubs attached).

Could you confirm which exec youd like on the 30m sync (Carlos ok?), and which slot(s) work? If neither works, propose 2 alternatives and Ill coordinate calendar invites.

If helpful, I can include a short one-pager on our Private deployment compliance posture for Carlos/security.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-capabilities-deck.pdf (PDF, 12 slides)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, draft)

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment & technical deep dive for Acme Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and next steps — that matches what I heard on our call. Carlos (ccd) can join the exec alignment. I’m pushing to get security on the technical deep dive but Carlos and I want to see the high-level alignment first so we’re comfortable inviting procurement.

Both suggested times should work on our side. Carlos prefers the Tue AM slot for the exec intro. If you can send a calendar invite for Tue May 14 at 10:00am PT for a 30m sync that would be great. For the technical deep dive, Wed May 15 at 3pm PT looks fine — Carlos will try to join but we’ll confirm security closer to the date.

Also can you include the one-pager on Private deployment compliance in the invite or email thread? Procurement will want it in the packet.

Thanks — excited to learn more.

Best,
Aisha Singh
VP Product, Acme Health
aisha.singh@acmehealth.com
+1 (212) 555-6242

Hi Aisha / Carlos —

Great — thanks for confirming. Calendar invites sent for both slots:
- Exec alignment: Tue May 14, 10:00–10:30am PT (30m) — invite includes Carlos and Aisha.
- Technical deep dive: Wed May 15, 3:00–3:45pm PT (45m) — Neha will lead the demo; I’ll kick off.

Neha (cc) will bring slides covering our runtime topology, private deployment flow, and a short checklist for security/prior evidence. I’ll attach the one-pager on Private deployment compliance to the invite and drop the capability deck + MAP to the HubSpot deal record.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2345 
Calendar event (exec intro): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-exec-align-20290514

If you or Carlos have any specific security artifacts you want ahead of the technical deep dive, let me know and Neha will prep. Otherwise we’ll run through architecture and typical SLA/rollback options and leave ~10m for compliance Qs.

Thanks all — see you Tue.

Best,
Marissa Cole
